title: 第63章 上辈子的兄弟！

第63章 上辈子的兄弟！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

迈巴赫沿着太湖北岸公路往市区方向压着速跑。

车窗外的法桐退成一条绿色的线。顾清烟靠在座椅上，手指搭着窗框，目光不经意地往右偏了一截。

林川闭着眼，呼吸很浅。

顾清烟收回视线，想开口又咽了回去。

林川的手机响了。

震动声在静谧的车厢里格外突兀。林川睁眼，低头看了一眼屏幕。

上海座机。陌生号码。

拇指已经挪到挂断键上了，停住。

号码尾号四位数——7923。

血液里某根弦被拨了一下。

前世。2019年冬天。他蹲在嘉定一个烂尾工地的活动板房里，口袋翻遍凑不出五十块钱吃饭。

手机欠费停机前收到的最后一条短信，是一笔三千块钱的转账。

转账人备注栏只写了四个字：先吃饱饭。

那个手机号尾号就是7923。

林川按下接听。

听筒里炸开一个嗓门，震得扬声器都在抖。

“操！林川！真是你小子啊？！你他妈什么时候来上海的？也不说一声！”

林川的嘴角往上翘。

“张虎。”

两个字，声音比平时低了半个调，尾音往上挑，像是在念一个很久没碰过的名字。

顾清烟的目光定住了。

从张江到太湖，从深圳到上海，她见过林川许多种表情。

对苏海亭的冷嘲、对秦宇的碾压、对沈荣庭的从容——每一种都精准、克制，计算过分寸。

唯独现在这个笑，什么都没算。

她从没见过林川笑成这样。

电话那头的大嗓门还在嚷：“你妹子说你在上海做生意？做什么生意？赚着没有啊？有啥困难跟我说啊！兄弟别跟我客气！”

林川靠回座椅，两根手指捏着手机，语气松垮得像回到了二十年前筒子楼下面的水泥台阶上。

“你怎么碰上我妹的？”

“嗐！我女朋友在财大教书，今天我开车去接她，在校门口差点撞你妹。一看那张脸——跟你丫一个模子刻出来的，我一喊，还真是！小冉把你号码给我了，我跟清清吃完饭就打了。”

“清清是谁？”

“我女朋友啊！宋清！你别岔开话题——你他妈到底在上海干什么？”

林川压着笑：“你现在在哪？”

“虹口区，刚送完人准备睡了。”

“别睡了，出来喝酒。”

电话那头安静了零点五秒，随即炸开。

“喝！你说地方！老子裤衩子都不换，出门就打车！”

林川报了一个地址。虹口区四川北路后面一条老弄堂，弄堂口有个没招牌的大排档。

不是外滩，不是金茂，更不是刚才太湖边上铺着波斯地毯的庄园。

挂断电话，林川把手机收进口袋。

顾清烟沉了两秒。“朋友？”

“上辈子的兄弟。”

Maybach was running at high speed along the Taihu North Shore Highway toward the city.

The French paulownia outside the car window retreated into a green line.Gu Qingyan leaned on the seat, put his fingers on the window frame, and inadvertently turned his eyes to the right.

Lin Chuan closed his eyes and breathed shallowly.

Gu Qingyan looked away, wanted to speak but swallowed it back.

Lin Chuan's cell phone rang.

The vibration sound was particularly abrupt in the quiet car.Lin Chuan opened his eyes and glanced down at the screen.

Shanghai landline.Unknown number.

Your thumb has moved to the hang up button and stopped.

The number ends in four digits - 7923.

A certain string in the blood was plucked.

previous life.Winter 2019.He squatted in a prefabricated house at an unfinished construction site in Jiading, rummaging through his pockets but unable to find fifty yuan for food.

The last text message I received before my phone went out of service was a transfer of 3,000 yuan.

There were only four words written in the remark column of the transferor: Eat a full meal first.

That mobile phone number ends in 7923.

Lin Chuan pressed the answer button.

A voice exploded in the receiver, making the speaker vibrate.

"Fuck! Lin Chuan! Are you really a brat?! When the hell did you come to Shanghai? You didn't even say a word!"

The corners of Lin Chuan's mouth turned upward.

"Zhang Hu."

The sound of the two words was half a tone lower than usual, and the ending sound was raised upward, as if he was pronouncing a name that he had not heard of for a long time.

Gu Qingyan's eyes were fixed.

From Zhangjiang to Taihu, from Shenzhen to Shanghai, she had seen many expressions of Lin Chuan.

The sarcastic treatment of Su Haiting, the crushing of Qin Yu, and the calm treatment of Shen Rongting - each of them is precise, restrained and calculated.

Only this smile now means nothing.

She had never seen Lin Chuan smile like this.

The loud voice on the other end of the phone was still shouting: "Your sister said you are doing business in Shanghai? What kind of business? Are you making money? Tell me if you have any difficulties! Don't be polite to me, brother!"

Lin Chuan leaned back in his seat, holding his mobile phone with two fingers, and spoke in a relaxed tone, as if he was back on the cement steps under the Tongzi Tower twenty years ago.

"How did you meet my sister?"

"Hey! My girlfriend teaches at the University of Finance and Economics. I drove to pick her up today and almost bumped into your sister at the school gate. When I saw that face - carved out of the same mold as yours, I shouted, it's true! Xiaoran gave me your number, and Qingqing and I called after dinner."

"Who is Qingqing?"

"My girlfriend! Song Qing! Don't change the subject - what the hell are you doing in Shanghai?"

Lin Chuan suppressed a smile: "Where are you now?"

"Hongkou District, we just finished seeing people off and are ready to go to bed."

"Don't sleep, come out and drink."

There was silence on the other end of the phone for half a second, and then it exploded.

"Drink! You said the place! I don't even change my pants, I just take a taxi when I go out!"

Lin Chuan reported an address.There is an old alley behind Sichuan North Road in Hongkou District. There is a food stall without a sign at the entrance of the alley.

Not the Bund, not Jinmao, and certainly not the manor with Persian carpets on the edge of Taihu Lake.

After hanging up the phone, Lin Chuan put the phone into his pocket.

Gu Qingyan fell silent for two seconds."Friends?"

"Brothers from the previous life."
